better_cooking.ponder.hands_on_preparati: Prepare together at a board or baking mat
Sneak-right-click the board or mat with an empty main hand to open Kitchen preparation. Keep the native station empty before using its preparation inventory.
For a listed assembly recipe: place its real ingredients in the nine inputs, Pick recipe, then Begin batch. This commits those ingredients, not a finished meal.
Keep the required tool in either hand and hold the preparation area. An unfinished hands-on stage needs a nearby connected player. Walking away or closing the menu pauses that active hold.

Completed repetitions and committed ingredients persist at this shared station. Another player can continue the same batch. Only an interrupted, unfinished active hold must be done again; the batch has no permanent player owner.

Native cutting is separate: lift the real cutting input onto your inventory cursor, use Next cut (input on cursor), and read the selected recipe ID and ordered output/chance tooltip. Selection consumes nothing.

Return the cursor stack to inventory and close the menu. Place that input on the board, then cut with a knife satisfying BOTH the KC knife tag and that recipe's source-tool predicate. Raw cuts do not use the held assembly timer.

Minced beef and native offal can share an input but remain different recipes. The shared board remembers your choice. An ambiguous unset or missing/mismatched choice refuses before payment; a paid board cannot switch recipes.

EMI lists every native route separately. Read output order, counts and percentages: 20% is a possibility, not a guaranteed extra item. Its Select button requires a valid open board menu and the matching real cursor input; tools are reusable catalysts.

Once the required hands-on work is genuinely complete, passive heat and supported automation can continue after the original cook leaves. Follow only available recipes; unavailable routes are not demonstrated as finished dishes.
better_cooking.ponder.pot_stir_serve.hea: Prepare, stir and serve at the pot
better_cooking.ponder.pot_stir_serve.tex: Use the actual recipe shown for the pot. A protected dish starts with its committed preparation batch; a recipe preview or raw ingredient is not a completed batch.
Place the pot above an appropriate working heat source. Follow its actual recipe's oil and input requirements; not every route accepts the same substitute ingredients.

Use the native kitchen shovel and perform the required stirs, then allow the native cooking time. A failed stir follows the actual failure result; do not treat waiting or this animation as successful preparation.
Collect the real completed result with that recipe's actual required container or native serving tool. A pictured bowl would not mean every dish accepts a bowl.
Age and quality come from the ingredients already committed to the batch. Previewing, transferring and serving do not reset freshness or roll a new quality bonus.
Follow the currently available pot recipe, not an assumed substitute dish. After hands-on stages are complete, passive cooking can continue without the original cook staying nearby.
better_cooking.ponder.stockpot_paid_serv: Serve real remaining portions before breaking
Use the qualified stockpot route's actual prepared batch, soup base, lid and cooking time. The batch has already committed real ingredients; its preview is not extra food.
A completed batch contains its actual recipe yield. Each successful take-out removes one real remaining portion. Reopening, saving or changing players must not refill it.

If the recipe requires an external container, bring that actual container for each portion. A bowl, bottle or other carrier is accepted only when its real recipe predicate allows it; no container is fabricated on break.
For finished food whose required containers have not yet been paid, serve it first. Breaking is refused before block removal or tool wear; do not assume breaking packages the remaining food for free.
Serve remaining food with required containers before breaking.
After serving, only the true remaining state can be recovered. A no-container or already-paid carrier route is different from an unpaid external-container route; never treat them as interchangeable.
An unfinished committed preparation is recovered as its actual batch, not promoted to cooked portions. Corrupt or mismatched state is not permission to mint replacement food.

The original cook does not own the pot. After the real preparation is complete, passive cooking and supported automation can continue; another player can serve the remaining portions with the correct containers.
better_cooking.ponder.pastry_typed_finis: Prepare on the mat, finish in the correct appliance
At the baking mat, open Kitchen preparation with an empty main hand while sneaking. Add the exact real ingredients, Pick recipe, Begin batch, then perform its tool and hold stages.
The output is the actual committed prepared batch, not automatically baked pastry. Transfer that same stack to the appliance required by its currently qualified finishing recipe.

An oven-style baking route uses the typed furnace-compatible finish and its real cooking time and fuel. A roasting route uses the typed campfire finish. One appliance is not a universal substitute for the other.
The pictured furnace is the source furnace-compatible path, not a promise that any modded oven is supported. Read the exact recipe. Do not use a raw-to-premium shortcut or a different batch's recipe.

The actual carried batch must match the current recipe and recorded preparation. Missing or obsolete preparation is refused. Roasting-spit/shawarma support is NOT claimed; its split and yield restrictions are separate.
Finishing transfers the actual old ingredient ages and batch quality. Moving through the mat, furnace or campfire does not manufacture a fresh clock, reroll quality or award intake before eating.

After real hands-on preparation is complete, passive furnace or campfire cooking does not require the original cook to remain online. Use only the exact available finishing recipe; no unlisted finished pastry is promised.
